sentences: A young woman in a white chemise sits in a large chair, her left hand touching her cheek and her head tilted gently to the right.
She is Jeanne Hébuterne, a young aspiring artist who met Modigliani in March 1917 and became his partner.
He painted her more than twenty times, usually emphasising her thick auburn hair and blue eyes.
The elongated figure and asymmetrical composition borrow the exaggerated elegance of sixteenth-century Italian Mannerist painting.
Born in Italy, Modigliani moved to Paris in 1906, where among the artists of Montmartre he developed his distinctive portraits with long oval faces.
The couple moved to the Côte d'Azur, where Jeanne gave birth to their daughter, and returned to Paris in May 1919, after which Modigliani's health declined quickly.
He died on 24 January 1920, and Jeanne, pregnant with their second child, died two days later.
